name: Legacy
source:
Legacy is a story about a nameless teenage boy caught in a series of unusual events. One afternoon, our protagonist encounters a young girl trying to take her own life at the top of the school's rooftop. From this encounter, his life was changed forever.

Sounds pretty generic? Well, there will be some pretty weird themes like time travel and mildly disturbing themes in this story as well!

[From [url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/legacy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Legacy》讲述了一名无名少年卷入一连串离奇事件的故事。一天下午，主人公在学校天台上遇见了一位试图轻生的少女。这场邂逅，从此改变了他的一生。

听起来很老套？别急，故事里还会出现时间旅行等相当奇异的题材，以及一些略显令人不安的内容！

[摘自[url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/legacy]Itch.io[/url]]
